about: The emulator cores Cable Club ships (point 7 of the evolution plan), read by build.ps1 (Windows) and android/app/build.gradle.kts (Android). The GPL asks that the source matching each binary can be given: a core is either taken from an official release ("release": tag, file and SHA-256 fixed here), or from the libretro buildbot ("buildbot"), in which case the build reads the commit the binary was built from ("commit": a regular expression, the commit is its last group) and fails when it cannot. Each build writes coeurs.txt and coeurs.json next to the cores; the release attaches the source of these exact commits and tags.
